title: Minimum on-site car parking spaces, R40 and below, outside Perth and Peel (Table 2.3b)
text: Applies to development outside of the Perth and Peel regions only. C2.3.3 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3b.

replaces.note: equals Part B Location B values; register ch2-024 rates the element 'mixed'

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: No Location A/B outside Perth and Peel. R40-and-below minimum stays 2 for 2+ bedrooms while Perth and Peel falls to 1. The table's second column (headed 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above') is encoded literally in C2.3.3-r2 and -r3; no R50+ minimum is stated.
